bio.text: Sasha Renée Pérez was elected to the 25th Senate District in November 2024 and chairs the Senate Education Committee.
She served as Mayor and Councilmember of Alhambra from 2020 to 2024, and earlier worked at the Pat Brown Institute for Public Affairs and the Campaign for College Opportunity.
Pérez was born and raised in Glendora and Alhambra and earned degrees in Political Science and Economics from California State University, Los Angeles.
